title: Persona 4 Golden

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Persona 4 Golden as the archive’s PC digital counterpart to the PlayStation 2 Persona 4 retail filing.
collectionNotes: Digital ownership confirmed via Steam. No physical edition, booklet, or insert is held for this accession. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art. The PlayStation 2 Persona 4 retail disc remains a separate physical filing.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account and Steam’s ongoing support for the title.
preservation.concerns: As with other account-bound Steam holdings: platform dependency, policy change, and the absence of a retained offline installer.
preservation.knownRevisions: Persona 4 Golden originated on PlayStation Vita. The Steam PC edition is dated June 13, 2020. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody and does not replace the North American PlayStation 2 Persona 4 reference copy (LIB-0037).
preservation.availability: Playable from the archive Steam library for as long as that license and storefront path remain intact.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

stewardshipHistory.note: Steam storefront / library artwork filed under the Library accession path.
Catalog identity, authority references, and digital-holding documentation aligned for publication.
Digital accession curated from Steam custody and set to Catalogued · Permanent Record.

synopsis: ATLUS’s Persona 4 Golden on Steam — the expanded PC edition retained in permanent digital custody within the Persona series.
